_comment: S11 Workstream B (the moonshot active tracker): = sitl3_lanes_vision.json geometry (convoy_3lane world, 3 diverging straight lanes, save_marker_frames ON) but each drone runs the track_convoy phase instead of sentry_scan — it locks ONE car's unique ArUco id (track_marker_ids) and bearing-pursues the moving car, keeping it under the nadir camera, then gives up cleanly on budget and lands. DRONE<->CAR: alpha->7, bravo->23, charlie->88 (per-drone zone.track_convoy.track_marker_ids). approach_enabled true: sim is exactly where open-loop translation is PROVEN (gate-E discipline keeps it OFF on real HULA until move/rotate accuracy is measured onsite). Pursuit is bearing-based (Rotate to center on bearing_deg, then Move FORWARD), bounded by max_chase_cm (open-loop runaway cap) and investigate_budget_s (wall-clock give-up). Run via sim/run_vision.sh track3 (PX4_GZ_WORLD=convoy_3lane + a straight slow convoy on 7/23/88). Endpoints/ports/timeouts identical to sitl3_lanes_vision.json. VM-TUNE on the box: CONVOY_LINEAR (car speed vs the drone's chase rate), approach_cm/max_step_deg/track_dwell_s (chase aggression vs lockstep RTF ~0.86), max_chase_cm (arena size). lead_gain stays 0 (azimuth lead needs onsite calibration); core is fixed-step bearing pursuit.
